description: I am a ninth grade student from Mykolaiv, Ukraine. I want to try my hand at a hackathon because I am interested in space, new technologies, mechanisms, and I dream of inventing a device that will be useful for all of humanity.
summary: Understanding outer space, history, getting to know two interesting spacecraft, and becoming aware of the problems of the present and the future.
details: From the project, we expect that people will be more aware of the concepts of space, spacecraft and the resources used for this. In addition, humanity should pay attention to the problem that we have described. We cannot assess the feasibility of this project, because we may have not taken into account some aspects of the present. To create the project, our team used the Microsoft 365 PowerPoint program in the browser and Google Translator for translation.
